title: Self-Hosted n8n Automation & AI Workflow Engine
description: Production-grade self-deployment of n8n workflow automation on custom cloud infrastructure at n8n.prataps.dev, powering autonomous AI agents and ML inference triggers
longDescription:
Self-deployed and configured a self-hosted instance of n8n workflow automation on a secure cloud server with automated SSL, custom domain routing (n8n.prataps.dev), and persistent PostgreSQL storage. Engineered to orchestrate complex multi-step automation pipelines, autonomous LLM agents, event-driven webhooks for machine learning inference, and seamless data synchronization across services.

Access is privately managed: If you want to access it, share an email to pratapsubramani@gmail.com or DM me.
keyFeatures: Containerized orchestration with Docker and PostgreSQL
Reverse proxy with automated SSL/TLS certificates and custom domain routing
Autonomous AI agent workflows and multi-LLM orchestration
Real-time webhook triggers for ML model inference and notification pipelines
Secure role-based access management with isolated credential stores
accessNote: If you want to access it, share an email to pratapsubramani@gmail.com or DM me.

title: CompanyRAG — Multimodal Knowledge & RAG Platform
description: Multi-tenant RAG platform featuring layered document ingestion (DOCX, OCR-supported PDF, PPTX), dense multilingual vector search, and selective Neo4j graph traversal.
longDescription: A multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation system engineered for enterprise document processing. Ingestion handles structured DOCX, page-by-page conditional OCR for scanned PDFs, PPTX slide decomposition, and tabular data with schema summarization. Retrieval pairs dense multilingual embeddings (BGE-M3 / E5) in Qdrant with selective entity-relationship traversal in Neo4j. Includes multi-tenant data isolation, a 6-tier deterministic precedence hierarchy for version updates, and a pre-generation confidence gate to eliminate ungrounded answers.
keyFeatures: Layered multi-format parsing with conditional page-by-page OCR
Hybrid retrieval combining dense vector search (Qdrant) and graph traversal (Neo4j)
Tenant isolation with PUBLIC, INTERNAL, and ADMIN_ONLY access scopes
Deterministic 6-tier conflict resolution for active document versions
Retrieval confidence check to prevent hallucinations on out-of-scope queries
Sub-50ms retrieval benchmarks validated with automated Pytest suites

title: n0tes — Minimal Electronic Notepad
description: A distraction-free sectional notepad with vintage stationery styling, debounced autosave, and serverless PostgreSQL persistence on the edge.
longDescription: An authentic, sectional notebook web application designed around classic desk stationery and Manila folder aesthetics. Features categorized folder tabs, instant in-section search, debounced autosave, print-optimized stylesheets, and plain-text export. Built with Next.js and @neondatabase/serverless for instant cold starts on Vercel Edge, backed by a local storage fallback layer for uninterrupted offline note-taking.
keyFeatures: Sectional folder tab organization with custom category creation
Debounced real-time autosave with sub-second serverless persistence
Built with @neondatabase/serverless for instant edge cold starts on Vercel
Resilient local storage fallback for offline note-taking
Print-optimized stylesheets and clean plain-text export

title: Titanian — Terminal Client for Titan AI Gateway
description: A lightweight terminal CLI client connecting to the Titan AI Gateway with chunked HTTP streaming, persistent session history, and explicit file permissions.
longDescription: A minimal, installable Python command-line interface (titanian) for communicating with the Titan AI Gateway directly from the terminal. Features real-time token streaming, multi-line prompt editing, rich session history persisted via JSON Lines (JSONL), and an explicit file-permission security module that prompts before reading local files. Designed with minimal dependencies for smooth execution across PowerShell and POSIX terminals.
keyFeatures: Standard pyproject packaging with installable system command (titanian)
Chunked HTTP response streaming with interactive multi-line terminal input
Explicit runtime file-read permission checks for secure operations
Session context persistence using structured JSON Lines (JSONL)
Low-dependency design tested on Windows PowerShell and bash environments

title: VIT-AP Student Marketplace Platform
description: Marketplace web application enabling VIT-AP students to buy, sell, and trade items within the campus community with real-time messaging capabilities
longDescription: Developed a marketplace web application enabling VIT-AP students to buy, sell, and trade items within the campus community with real-time messaging capabilities. Implemented secure authentication and authorization using Clerk with role-based access control for students and administrators, including email domain validation for campus-exclusive access. Designed and built RESTful APIs for post management, conversation handling, and user profiles with PostgreSQL database integration using Neon serverless architecture. Created responsive UI components with real-time message notifications, image upload functionality via Cloudinary, and dynamic filtering by categories and hostels. Integrated middleware for protected routes, onboarding workflows, and implemented error boundaries for robust error handling and improved user experience.

title: Hybrid CNN-Transformer for Skin Texture Analysis
description: Hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture to analyze and classify skin textures with 82% test accuracy
longDescription: Implemented a Hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture combining convolutional layers for local features and transformer blocks for global context. Applied data preprocessing techniques including normalization and augmentation to improve generalization. Evaluated performance using accuracy and loss metrics; achieved 82% test accuracy.

title: Career Guidance Chatbot
description: AI-powered recommendation system for career suggestions using structured user profiling and LLM-based intent understanding
longDescription: Built a recommendation system for career suggestions using structured user profiling and data persistence mechanisms. Developed back-end using Flask and SQLAlchemy; managed analytics using AWS Lambda for performance reporting. Integrated Gemini API to enhance LLM-based intent understanding and improve recommendation accuracy.

title: AI-Powered Sentiment Analysis Platform
description: Deployed sentiment models combining lexicon and transformer-based methods for scalable, real-time insights from web reviews
longDescription: Deployed sentiment models combining lexicon and transformer-based methods for scalable, real-time insights from web reviews. Automated real-time web scraping to collect datasets and support competitor analysis. Created interactive dashboards with trend visualizations for decision-making.

title: Trip Planner & Blog Creator
description: LLM-powered itinerary generator with mapping and storytelling modules, integrating multi-source data for user personalization
longDescription: Developed an LLM-powered itinerary generator with mapping and storytelling modules, integrating multi-source data for user personalization. Enabled structured export of itineraries as PDFs for enhanced user experience and offline access.

title: AI Startup Simulator
description: An AI-powered startup simulation platform that allows users to create, validate and iterate startup ideas through realistic AI-driven interactions. The platform simulates founders, investors, customers and market conditions, enabling users to evaluate business ideas before investing time or resources into real-world development.
longDescription: An AI-powered startup simulation platform that allows users to create, validate and iterate startup ideas through realistic AI-driven interactions. The platform simulates founders, investors, customers and market conditions, enabling users to evaluate business ideas before investing time or resources into real-world development. Built with Next.js and a FastAPI backend, the platform leverages LLM APIs to generate dynamic, context-aware feedback at every stage of the startup journey. PostgreSQL stores all simulation state, while Docker enables consistent deployment across environments.

title: Oracle Cloud Code Generator
description: An enterprise-grade AI-powered code generation platform designed for Oracle Cloud environments. The platform converts natural language requirements into structured enterprise code, accelerating software development while maintaining consistency, scalability and maintainability.
longDescription: An enterprise-grade AI-powered code generation platform designed for Oracle Cloud environments. The platform converts natural language requirements into structured enterprise code, accelerating software development while maintaining consistency, scalability and maintainability. Built with Next.js frontend and FastAPI backend, the platform integrates directly with Oracle Cloud services for deployment-ready output. Docker containers ensure reproducible builds, while PostgreSQL tracks project metadata and generated artifacts.

title: Customer Experience Platform for Tanishq
description: An AI-powered customer engagement platform developed for modern jewellery retail. The system assists customers through guided conversations, customer profiling, personalized recommendations and intelligent visual product discovery using multimodal AI.
longDescription: An AI-powered customer engagement platform developed for modern jewellery retail. The system assists customers through guided conversations, customer profiling, personalized recommendations and intelligent visual product discovery using multimodal AI. Built with a FastAPI backend and Next.js frontend, the platform integrates Florence and DINOv2 embeddings for visual search, FAISS for image retrieval, and PostgreSQL for customer profiles and conversation history.
